articles.summary: How did Arnold Palmer order an Arnold Palmer? You know, the half-lemonade, half-iced-tea concoction named in his honor? Steve Politi, sports columnist at NJ.com, unearthed the answer years ago , at Augusta National Golf Club, where a waitress who served Palmer his drink told him: "He leaned over and said, 'I'll have a Mr. Palmer.' articles.title: How Voting Rights Impacted the 2026 Midterms
articles.summary: On January 3, Scott Colom will be sworn in as the 52 nd United States Senator from Mississippi. Perhaps more importantly, Colom will be the first Black Mississippian elected to statewide office since Reconstruction —and the first Black Mississippian ever popularly elected to the U.S. Senate by voters in the Magnolia State. articles.title: America's Top Manufacturers of 2027
articles.summary: As major U.S. manufacturers have increasingly moved their production overseas in the last few decades to reduce costs, President Trump ’s hallmark global tariffs were designed to force these companies to do their manufacturing stateside. But the tariffs proved unpopular , with the conservative think tank Cato Institute reporting in August that there is no factory building boom and that manufacturing is only expanding in industries facing the lowest tariffs , like electronics. articles.title: How TIME and Statista Determined America's Top Manufacturers of 2027
articles.summary: For the first edition of America’s Top Manufacturers , TIME and Statista have joined forces to recognize 250 leading U.S. manufacturers. As companies navigate shifting supply chains and evolving workforce demands, the ranking highlights performance across three equally weighted dimensions: financial performance, innovation capacity, and employment.
